texts.facts: In this case, a detailed accident report was filed by police in terms of provisions of Motor Vehicle Act and same is treated as Claim Petition in view of the provisions contained in such Act. 2. As per the investigation carried out by concerned police official, the information regarding present accident was received through DD entry no. 26A dated 12.10.2019, PS Lajpat Nagar. Upon receipt of such DD entry, police official ASI Taiyub proceeded to spot of accident near Lajpat Nagar Metro Station, where a motorcycle bearing No. DL3CDY 0848 HF Delux XE (Hero) of red black colour was found in accidental condition and he met ASI Umesh Chand on the spot, who revealed that driver Yashpal had committed the accident on account of rash and negligent driving of offending motorcycle causing injuries to HC O.K. Nair, who was taken to AIIMS Trauma Center by Ct. Charanjeet. Subsequently, GD No. 21A was received from AIIMS Trauma Center where injured was taken for treatment and his MLC was collected upon while final opinion was kept awaited whereas injured was declared fit for statement so his statement was recorded. Victim/ injured/ claimant mentioned in his statement that he was posted as Head Constable in Traffic Circle, Defence Colony and was on duty at Traffic Point, Lajpat Nagar Metro Station on 12.09.2019 from 8 a.m. till 10 p.m. alongwith Ct. Charanjeet and while they were issuing challan receipts under footover bridge at DRT Corridor near Lajpat Nagar Metro Station, on the carriage way to Mool Chand Hospital that he spotted a motorcycle bearing No. DL3CDY 0848 HF Delux red black colour at about 12 p.m. with two riders, both without helmet that he signaled them to stop, however driver Yashpal instead speeded the vehicle and drove rashly and negligently hitting him. He sustained injuries and the motorcyclist was MACT No.: 285/2021 . Page No. 2 of 30 :3: caught on the spot itself, whereas pillion rider fled from the scene and injured was rushed to AIIMS Trauma Center. Upon recording the statement, present case FIR was got registered under provisions of Section 279/337 IPC, 129/177 and 132/179 M.V. Act. During investigation, it was revealed that the offending vehicle was without insurance and was being driven by Yashpal driver without a valid and effective driving license. Statement of witnesses under Section 161 Cr.P.C. have been recorded. Mechanical inspection of offending vehicle was got conducted. Nature of injury was opined to be grievous. Upon conclusion of investigation, IO filed charge sheet under Section 279/338 IPC and 132/179 M.V. Act against respondent No. 1 (driver-cum-owner). DAR was filed by Investigating Officer before this Tribunal. 3. It can be seen from the record from the R-1 (Driver-cum- Owner) appeared on the very first date before the court. On 09.08.2023, claimant examined himself in chief as PW-1. Such PW1 tendered his evidence by way of affidavit as Ex.PW1/A. He relied upon various documents including identification proof, Employment Identity Card, Salary Slip, Treatment Re Medical/Fitness Certificate, medical bills and copy of DAR as Ex. PW-1/1 to Ex. PW-1/6. 7.
